Mother '''Darvale''' is the [[Wisdom]] of [[Runnien Crossing]] in [[Altara]].

==Appearance==
Mother Darvale is a lean woman with leathery skin and white hair.{{ref/book|11|8}}

==Activities==
When [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]] arrives near Runnien Crossing, the mayor and Mother Darvale demand free admission for themselves and their families. They also require that the show moves out of the way of any merchants that might happen by. The next day, she marries [[Egeanin Tamarath]] and [[Bayle Domon]].{{ref/book|11|8}}
